harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: node1 now serves a signed local RPM repository at 10.100.112.10:8080. `localrepo-demo-1.0.0-1.el10` was installed from it while outbound HTTPS—and therefore the usual Red Hat repositories—was deliberately unreachable. RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0 were preserved, and the repository recovered after a verified node reboot. subscription-manager automatically regenerated redhat.repo during transactions; its managed status and enabled BaseOS/AppStream repositories remain intact.
actions_performed: Built a release-compatible noarch POSIX-shell RPM.
Generated protected signing credentials on node1 and signed both RPM content and repository metadata.
Created an enabled, hardened systemd HTTP service with SELinux enforcing and firewall access restricted to 10.100.112.0/24.
Configured DNF with package and repository-metadata signature verification.
Proved the Red Hat CDN was unreachable during a local-only DNF installation, then removed the temporary outage rule.
Removed build, recovery, download, and cache artifacts.
Restarted node1 safely and verified changed boot identity plus complete service and data recovery.

evidence.requirement: Serve a signed repository from local storage
evidence.summary: Repository metadata and RPM signatures validate; the hardened service listens on the managed address; DNF recognizes the signed node1-local repository.

evidence.requirement: Install a package while usual remote repositories are unreachable
evidence.summary: The package was initially absent and the CDN reachable; during the bounded HTTPS outage the CDN failed, while DNF installed exclusively from node1-local and the installed command executed successfully.

evidence.requirement: Preserve the operating-system release, kernel, security, and administrative access
evidence.summary: Before and after evidence shows RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0 unchanged, SELinux enforcing, SSH active, no failed units, protected signing material, and the release-compatible RPM toolchain.
Build/recovery/test artifacts were removed and the cached RPM count is zero.

Healthy baseline boot ID 636556ce-a308-49cc-b873-62cedb1c077d was captured, the safe reboot was acknowledged, disconnection was observed, boot ID changed to 4a459d18-0263-47e0-bbed-ef60bb6b7f5f, and service, listener, firewall, signed data, installed package, and system health recovered.
